description: Hi everyone! I’m Hari, a Biomedical Scientist and a space enthusiast. I created this team for the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge because every rover wheel, lander and parachute left on the Moon and Mars is a silent monument to human ingenuity. Our goal is to turn NASA’s historical mission data into an engaging, interactive storytelling experience that gives these "forgotten" artifacts a voice.
summary:
We developed Hardware Historians, an interactive digital museum and field guide showcasing NASA’s discarded hardware across the Moon and Mars. Built as an interactive clickable prototype using official NASA archival photography, mission logs, and orbital coordinates, our guide lets users explore landing sites, inspect iconic artifacts—from Apollo descent stages to Mars’ Opportunity rover—and read first-person narrative transmissions from each machine.
This directly addresses the challenge by transforming dense technical mission archives into an intuitive, emotionally engaging visual experience accessible to audiences of all ages. Rather than treating expended hardware as mere space debris, our field guide highlights the engineering breakthroughs and human stories behind each relic.
Preserving these stories is vital: these silent monuments represent humanity’s first archaeological footprints beyond Earth, inspiring future generations and honoring the engineering sacrifices paving the way for Artemis and human Mars exploration.
details: Cosmic Relics: Off-World Field Guide, developed by Team Hardware Historian for the NASA Space Apps Challenge is an interactive web-based digital museum that maps and honors NASA’s discarded hardware across the Moon and Mars.Built using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Web Audio APIs, the platform combines authentic NASA coordinates, CAD-style blueprints, and creative first-person narrative logs ("The Machine's Voice") to transform dense technical telemetry into an engaging storytelling experience. Its core impact is reframing off-world artifacts from "space debris" into monumental archaeological landmarks of human ingenuity, preserving aerospace heritage, and inspiring future explorers.
